factors: Seventeen time-mapped creator claims and four supplemental original or operational claims require bounded evidence separation.
Provider-specific cache accounting, quantitative examples, architecture and privacy/security tradeoffs warrant extended assessment.
complexity.rationale: A short video makes consequential and sometimes unverified claims across provider economics, agent architecture, and context management; each material statement is assessed separately.

sourceMap.rationale: Habits make users consume tokens/limits more quickly. PARTIAL: repeated input economics supported; no universal doubling or subscription limits quantified
Conversation is reread every turn. PARTIAL: logical context and prefill explained; reject literal universal full resend/recompute with provider state
Seven tasks: ~160M input, ~0.5M output, roughly 200:1. Unverified creator report: no original logs or accounting denominator. The rounded figures imply 320:1 rather than the stated approximate 200:1.
Prompt prefix caching reduces repeated processing and read rates. SUPPORTED mechanism; read prices model-specific, context and latency distinct
Editing an earlier token invalidates subsequent prefix. PARTIAL; eligible previous boundary can survive; certain supported additions preserve reuse
Switching from warm Opus to cold Haiku can cost more. PARTIAL; exact anecdotal pricing/employee attribution UNKNOWN; illustrative comparison demonstrates conditions and counterexample
Configure upfront, append, prefer scoped subagents to switching. PARTIAL; tool and model changes affect reuse, no absolute prohibition; evaluate handoff/rework and new authorization
Expiry roughly one hour on subscription and five minutes on API. PARTIAL; API five-minute default and longer options verified; exact subscription behavior UNKNOWN

~400k cache rebuild $3.50, refresh ~$0.08. Unverified specific creator numbers; official documentation supports the mechanism only. The Reader illustrates an expected-value inequality, not a recommendation to keep idle sessions warm.
One long unrelated session costs more than short focused sessions. PARTIAL; plausible tail size/attention savings, cold repeated setup may reverse outcome
Claude Code cache hit rate generally in 90s, attributed to product leader. UNKNOWN specific population/metric/attribution; no equating with vendor's separate API cohort or GhostMesh sample
Clear or compact at a task boundary. SUPPORTED bounded mechanism; compacted summary may lose constraints and first request can miss existing prefix. Use tested checkpoint and compare forward costs

Precise repo/file routing avoids excessive reads. Supported as an architectural mechanism; the documentation and observed discovery case illustrate selective retrieval. No measured reduction is promised.
Anthropic cut roughly 80% of certain system prompts. UNKNOWN exact private implementation/number; do not delete controls to target a ratio
Reassess skills as models improve, prune irrelevant detail. PARTIAL; test behavior and keep discoverability, evidence and authority functions
Progressive disclosure: metadata, then instruction, then needed resources. SUPPORTED; not proof every agent consumes an installed descriptor
Recap and creator community promotion. Covered, not a technical performance claim or recommendation to buy/join

sourceCoverage.rationale: Seventeen source-mapped creator claims across nine chapter starts with approximate Whisper timing and explicit source limitations.

supportingArgument.rationale: Explains four distinct reuse units and accepted-outcome economics without conflating computation, billing, logical context or retrieval.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Creator reports, marked unverified metrics, first-party API documents, bounded operational observations and original examples retain separate evidentiary roles.

counterargument.rationale: Addresses cold-start overhead, model switching reversal, cache misses, stale evidence and infrastructure that may cost more than it saves.

tradeoffs.rationale: Explicit compaction loss, keep-alive uncertainty, model choice, retention, source freshness and authorization tradeoffs.

falsifiability.rationale: Proposes controlled cold/warm workloads, changed revision and revoked-access cases, acceptance rubrics, and route/counter attestation.

originalSynthesis.rationale: Four independent validity layers and actual discovery failure case provide architectural analysis beyond the creator recommendations.

performance.rationale: No unmeasured latency, physical KV reuse, fleet-wide hit rate or causal performance improvement asserted.

economics.rationale: Reader-specific examples and equations independently recomputed, with stated assumptions, explicit countercases and accepted-job denominator.

threatGovernance.rationale: Current authority at reuse, audience separation, revocation, retention, source trust and validation are treated as distinct from cache eligibility.

gaps.rationale: One otherwise relevant canonical SharePlane Work currently resolves to an explicitly unaccepted Development revision; owner decision to replace or clarify the relationship is outstanding.

decisionRationale: Independent review accepted the substantive argument and method for owner visual consideration but returned REVISE for a single live relationship destination. Hold at draft, no publication or owner acceptance implied.
